I love to teach! I have had the opportunity to mentor high school interns and undergraduate students in mechanical design,
CAD, 3D printing / digital fabrication, and other fundamental concepts in soft robotics. This included hands-on training on the Prusa, Carbon M1, and
Stratasys J750 3D printers, Instron material testing system, as well as design for additive manufacturing and Python programming.
